design_philosophy: A bold, 'impossible to ignore' UI optimized for creators. We use Neo-Brutalism (hard black borders, solid pastel blocks, sharp shadows) to reject standard SaaS minimalism. High contrast, highly legible, optimistic, and tactile. Avoid generic soft gray SaaS interfaces.

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8 align-items-start
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, dense content. Never center-everything.

surfaces_and_shadows.input: bg-white border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#0A0A0A] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-primary rounded-md px-4 py-2
surfaces_and_shadows.button: font-bold border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#0A0A0A] active:translate-x-[4px] active:translate-y-[4px] active:shadow-none transition-all rounded-md px-6 py-3

components_strategy.navigation: Solid background `#F4F3ED` with hard 2px bottom border `#0A0A0A`. Sticky top. Brand logo in `Cabinet Grotesk` font-black.
components_strategy.dashboard_scheduler: Calendar UI must use dense mode `grid-cols-7`. Drag and drop items should have the Neo-brutalist card hover effect. Avoid faint gray borders; use distinct black borders for grid lines. Do not use generic Shadcn soft cards.
components_strategy.ai_content_generator: Use the `ai_accent` (#D4FF33) for the AI Generation block to make it pop. Use ASCII art loaders or heavy typography for generation states.
components_strategy.badges: Pill-shaped, heavy 1.5px border, bright pastel background (pink/blue/yellow) with black text.
components_strategy.forms: Inputs must have heavy borders and solid shadows. Over-communicate focus state with a primary color border change. Use Shadcn components but strip the Vercel-look.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Translate X and Y by 2px/4px to 'push down' the shadow, mimicking a physical button press.
motion_and_interactions.loading: ASCII art loaders or rapid text marquee 'GENERATING...' instead of standard spinners.

icons.style: Stroke width 2.5 or 3. High contrast, slightly chunky to match the brutalist typography.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract brutalist calendar representation for landing page or empty states.

ai_feature.description: AI generation abstract UI graphic for the AI Content Engine section.

auth_background.description: Creator workspace desk. Use as a split-screen background for Auth pages (Login/Signup).

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST implement this using Tailwind CSS. Do not use custom CSS files for styles unless absolutely necessary.
Include Fontshare CDN links for `Cabinet Grotesk` and `Satoshi` in the HTML head.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button').
Never use `Inter`, `Roboto`, or generic sans for headings.
NO PURPLE or TEAL. Use the defined Primary (#FF4500) and AI Accent (#D4FF33).
All cards, buttons, and inputs MUST feature the 2px black border and hard shadow (`shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]`).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for text-heavy areas over images.
Forms must use customized Shadcn components but override their borders and shadows to match the neo-brutalist theme.
The layout must be built with a Dashboard sidebar and a main content area using the Bento grid for analytics.
For the calendar scheduler, use a 7-column CSS grid. Day cells must have 1px solid black borders, not faint gray.
